analytical_author: Codex; no legacy WLW direction records and no Python discretionary forecast engine
preweek_rule: Only completed source rows with close_time <= final preweek completed cutoff. Validate endpoints and recompute indicators on the causal prefix.
reconstruction_disclosure: All twenty forecasts are newly reconstructed now. Prior outcomes are already available to the analyst, so this is not blind, prospective or out-of-sample accuracy.
map_freeze_rule: Freeze explicit Codex-authored levels, scenario direction, first target and H4 failure threshold for every week before the comparison script is run. Store actual reconstruction timestamp and hypothetical replay interval separately; no historical valid_from or live entry eligibility.

scoring_contract.primary_direction_body_agreement: Compare declared primary hypothesis direction with actual close minus open. Numeric agreement only; not conditional scenario or trade win rate.
scoring_contract.primary_direction_dominant_excursion_agr: Compare declared primary direction with the larger of high-open and open-low, matching the earlier report metric.
scoring_contract.scenario_evidence: Report first M15 origin-zone intersection, target-zone intersection, and first completed H4 close across each declared failure threshold. Codex interprets the chronology; Python only extracts timestamps/values.
scoring_contract.no_credit_for_alternate_as_primary_hit: Activation of a plausible alternate must not change a missed primary-direction forecast into a hit.
scoring_contract.entry_performance: Not scored: M15 qualification/trigger, M30 confirmation, H1 permission and confirmation-time no-chase are not fully replayed in this weekly map comparison. Zone touches alone receive no entry or trade-success claim.

history_is_not_deterministic_code_replay: The reference forecast was discretionary Codex analysis. Same factual extractor, windows and written procedure can be reused; exact historical model judgment cannot be guaranteed by a code hash.
